search_and_update_rules.name: Replace StemGuard Junior Description
search_and_update_rules.target_value:
Introducing StemGuard Lite 2.0 Junior.

The lightest neck protector on the market is here.

Built on the DNA of Masuri’s industry-leading StemGuard PRO, the all-new StemGuard Lite 2.0 raises the bar — delivering greater freedom of movement than any neck protector available, while still providing more than double the protection required by the safety standard.

Engineered from Masuri PRO-FOAM, the pre-curved single-piece design contours naturally to the neck for maximum ergonomic comfort. Clips directly onto any current Masuri Junior steel grill helmet.

Compliant with BS 7928:2013+A1 2019.
